AMAZON RAINFOREST TOURS

What Will you Discover?

VISIT MANU NATIONAL PARK FROM CUSCO, PERU

LOCAL. WILD. AUTHENTIC.

CONTACT
ABOUT

VISIT THE MANU NATIONAL PARK WITH A LOCAL COMPANY

Going to the Amazon rainforest is a dream for many travelers while planning their South American travel. If you’re looking for an amazing jungle trip near Cusco, Peru, you’re in the right place. 

The Manu National Park is accessible by road & riverfrom Cusco. It is located on the Madre de Dios and Manu rivers, which are tributaries to the Amazon itself.  Our founder grew up in the small village of Nuevo Eden that we use as our base; the rainforest is his home. 

We offer multi-day guided small group tours and can also organize independent trips to Manu: whichever you prefer. All of our jungle tours can be added onto your Cusco trip while visiting Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley. You will get a taste of local life, and opportunities to see amazing creatures in their natural habitat.

 

OUR TOURS: SOMETHING FOR EVERYONE

We have thoughtfully created our jungle trips for travelers with different budgets, different interests, and different timeframes.  For Maximum wildlife viewing: the Wildlife Tour is for you. If you want to visit local villages and pay a little less, the road trip was made for you. The Expedition is for adventure seekers who wish to travel deep in the jungle, learning survival skills and getting far away from civilization. 

Jungle Wildlife Tour

Manu National Park tours from Cusco where you will travel by van through the cloud forest, and look for animals of the Peruvian amazon by boat. You will enjoy beautiful scenery, local food, and witness incredible nature. The real highlight of this trip is getting to search for animals native to Peru in their natural habitat. You will have the opportunity to see caimans, macaws, capybaras, and the ellusive jaguar. Our Amazon tours from Cusco are appropriate for all kinds of travelers. 

  • Tour duration: 3 day, 4 day, 5 day, 6 day or 8 day options
  • Group Size: 2 – 8 passengers
  • Travel: By private van and by boat
Learn more

TEMPORARILY UNAVAILABLE Rainforest Road Trip

Our most authentic and local Peru amazonas tour will take you on a journey through villages along the winding road from Cusco to the Manu National Park. We will spot animals in the cloud forest, taste local flavors, and visit some hidden gems on this jungle trip. This trip includes only a very short boat ride, and is great for small, adventerous groups who want to visit the Amazon on a budget. 

*Note: this trip is not availibile from December – March (Rainy season)*

  • Tour duration: 4 day or 5 day options
  • Group Size: 1 – 3 passengers
  • Travel: By private 4×4
Learn more

TEMPORARILY UNAVILABLE Manu Expedition

Perfect for adventerous nature lovers, our jungle expedition will take you deep into the forest to search for animals native to Peru. You will camp, fish, hike, and learn survival skills. You will travel by van through the cloud forest, then boat to search for animals on the riverbanks, and then hike deep into the forest, using rubber boots. Our experienced and local travel team will organize everything for an amazing  trip. 

  • Tour duration: 5-day or 6-day options
  • Group Size: 2 – 8 passengers
  • Travel: Private van, private boat, hiking in the jungle
Learn more

WILDLIFE IN THE PERUVIAN RAINFOREST

The Manu National Park is the best place to see wildlife in Peru, for you will always see animals in their natural habitats, surrounded by a complex ecosystem. When we visit the Amazon rainforest, we will explore trails, looking for monkeys, macaws, insects, snakes, and more. On the river banks we will search for capybaras, turtles, caimans, and even a jaguar, in Peru.

Google Reviews

Vamos a la selva! Plan your trip today.

Where Are We? Check out the Map

FAMILY BUSINESS
SUPPORTING LOCALS

We live in Peru, we love Peru. We work with our family and local professionals to operate our tours to Manu National Park.

GUIDED TOURS OR INDEPENDANT TRIPS

We offer both guided tours and can also help organize local trips for travelers who want to visit Manu with more flexibility

SUSTAINABLE
TOURISM

The Amazon Rainforest is one of our planet's mose important areas, and it's in danger. We are passionate about using tourism as a positive force to care for the jungle and it's inhabitants.
